prompt.title: Never miss an emergency
prompt.intro: Turn on notifications: we’ll alert you when the game is in the background or closed.
prompt.benefitIncidents: New calls, and emergencies about to expire with no units
prompt.benefitClosed: Completed missions, with the outcome and the Credits earned
prompt.benefitMajor: Major incidents, patients in danger and broken-down vehicles
prompt.benefitControl: Choose what you receive and your quiet hours, in Settings
prompt.note: Your browser will ask for permission: choose “Allow”. Never a notification while you’re playing.

denied.title: Notifications blocked
denied.intro: Your browser blocks Rescue Control’s notifications, so we can’t alert you about new emergencies.
denied.browser: tap the icon to the left of the address (the padlock or site settings) → Notifications → Allow, then reload the page.
denied.macSafari: open Safari → Settings → Websites → Notifications, choose “Allow” for Rescue Control and reload the page.
denied.androidApp: press and hold the Rescue Control icon → App info → Notifications, turn them on and reopen the game.
denied.iosApp: open Settings → Notifications → Rescue Control and turn on “Allow Notifications”.

ios.title: Notifications on iPhone and iPad
ios.intro: On iPhone and iPad, notifications only come from Rescue Control added to the Home Screen.
ios.after: Open the game from its Home Screen icon: you can turn on notifications there.

result.enabledBody: We’ll alert you when the game isn’t in front.
result.blockedBody: You can allow them any time from the site settings of your browser.
result.failed: Couldn’t turn on notifications. Try again from Settings.
result.unavailable: Notifications aren’t available on this device.
